Rotate into high-beta local winners with earnings momentum; avoid US-exposed tech until Fed signals shift.

themes: Indonesia's domestic coal demand for power generation is structurally rising, insulating local miners from global price swings and supporting sustained earnings growth.

Liquidity rotation into small-cap energy names like SQMI and ALKA reflects speculative retail flows, but institutional money favors large-cap operators with proven reserves and ESG compliance.
sectors.ai: Buy selective coal-to-power names (BUMI, CUAN) on the IDX rally, but avoid chasing speculative movers like SQMI and ALKA, which lack fundamental support. The sector's positive divergence from US weakness signals domestic demand strength, yet WATCH status demands discipline—take profits on FIRE and SAMF gains, and rotate into high-volume, cash-generative miners with export visibility.

Rotate into NOVN for vaccine upside. Maintain neutral US exposure; MRNA/CVS rallies are sentiment-driven, not structural.
